mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a given month coincides with a decline in 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to higher discount rates eroding expected future cash flows.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, the 20-day forward return remains positive despite persistent FEDFUNDS > 5.25%, or the 5.25% threshold is not met for ≥3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor market additions) of at least 20,000 coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as hiring momentum signals economic resilience and consumer confidence.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥20,000 in a month
failure_condition: In 20 consecutive months of labor market loosening, the 20-day forward return remains negative despite PAYEMS increases ≥20,000, or the increase is below 20,000 in all months during a recovery phase.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly rise in both HOUST (residential construction) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their prior month's levels predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as it reflects strengthening demand across housing and consumer discretionary sectors.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous and RSAFS > previous in the same month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, the 60-day forward return is not statistically higher than baseline when both HOUST and RSAFS are above prior month's levels.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) of at least 2 points for three consecutive months predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as it signals supply-side softness and potential recession risk.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by ≥2 points for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: During such a supply shock, the 20-day forward return is positive or indistinguishable from a no-signal baseline (p > 0.10 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL (CPI) rises by more than 0.3% in a month and FEDFUNDS remains below 4%, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver a positive 5-day forward return as the surprise inflation is priced in before the next FOMC meeting.
regime_hint: Inflation surprise with policy still restrictive
failure_condition: Over 10 such inflation surprises, the 5-day forward return is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE decline below 4.0% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as it reflects weakening labor market conditions and potential wage moderation.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: During such a regime, the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of instances, or the threshold is not met for ≥4 months in a row.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in GDPC1 (real personal consumption) of at least 1% predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as it signals cooling demand and risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls by ≥1% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In 5 such late-cycle declines, the 20-day forward return is not statistically negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When both INDPRO and HOUST fall simultaneously by at least 3 points in the same month, the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 60 days due to simultaneous supply and housing weakness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by ≥3 points and HOUST falls by ≥3 points in the same month
failure_condition: During such events, the 60-day forward return is not negative in more than 30% of cases (p > 0.70).
